title: Stellar Born
start: Investigate a mysterious crashed star in Piscatoris.

items.t: Wizard Blizzard or Premade Wizard Blizzard

recommended.t: Stardust will teleport you directly to Wizard Rosalina
Alternatively, wicked hood, fairy ring DIS, or other means of teleporting to the Wizards' Tower
Memory strand, fairy ring AKQ, or other means of teleporting to Piscatoris
'Chipped' Watchtower teleport or other means of teleporting to the Observatory
Leela's favour will teleport you to Menaphos Merchant district near Desert goebie camp
Shadow's Grace relic power or Mobile on an augmented armour piece (weapons will be unequipped for various parts of the quest)

rewards.t: Access to meteorites for meteorite chunks, which can be crushed into dust to create meteorite cannonballs that deal 150% damage. Requires level 85 Mining to mine, 85 Crafting to crush, and 85 Smithing to smith the cannonballs.
Access to a new single flower patch with +25% yield when growing Starbloom.
5% increased experience when mining shooting stars

steps.t: Talk to the crashed star west of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony. [Chat: Accept]
p: A mysterious crashed star found in Piscatoris.

steps.t: Mine the crashed star and finish the dialogue.
Go to the south side of the floor 3 of the Wizard's Tower and talk to Wizard Rosalina. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Stellar Born'. › Any › Any]
: Players can quickly teleport to her with stardust.
Return to the crashed star west of Piscatoris.
Talk to Wizard Rosalina to hand her your cosmic and astral runes and the Wizard Blizzard drink. Finish the cutscene.
p: Talking to Wizard Rosalina with Zoob.

steps.t: Head to the desert goebie camp, north-west of Menaphos.
: Players can use Leela's favour to get to the Merchant District (option 2) and exit through the north Menaphos gate.
p: Talking to Wizard Chambers in goebie camp.

steps.t: Talk to Wizard Chambers. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Stellar Born'.]
Return to the Piscatoris crash site and talk to Wizard Chambers or Wizard Rosalina.
Talk to them again.
Shoo away fireflies to keep them away from the crashed star until the portal progress at the top of your screen reaches 50.
Talk to them again.

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Teleport to Zolarea with the portal.

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Unequip any items in your main/off-hand slots and jump the rocky edge to the east.
p: Flying around Zolarea with the wingsuit.

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Fly to the large island to the east and jump to the rocky edge to land.

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: : Players can Surge and Dive during flight.

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Head south-east to the giant crystal towards the centre and talk to Wizard Rosalina. [Chat: Any]

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Jump the rocky edge on the northernmost side of the main island.

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Head to the north-easternmost island and inspect the mysterious decay.

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Return to the main island and then inspect the mysterious decay south of the rocky edge and west of the flower patch.

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Attempt to enter the cave entrance to the west of the giant crystal. (1/12)

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Head to the south side of the main island and inspect the mysterious decay (2/12), then talk to Rox. (3/12)

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Head west to the southernmost house and lift the woven rug, then talk to Nuub. (4/12)

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Talk to Blip near Wizard Rosalina. (5/12)

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: Talk to Wizard Rosalina. [Chat: 1 I found some information... › 2 Parts of the planet are dying. › 1 There is a cave in the center of the planet. › 3 The cave is where the elder star sprites go to die. › 1 The cave is where their power source can be found.]

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: : If the necessary chat options display "???", you missed a clue.

steps.sec: Exploring the homeland of star sprites
steps.t: : If done correctly, you receive a wrinkly scroll.
Head to the observatory west of Tree Gnome Village and north of Castle Wars.
: The fastest teleport is 'Chipped' Watchtower teleport made by Dave's spellbook.
: See other ways of getting there.
Climb the rope attached to the broken stairs north-east of the observatory, then go up the stairs inside the observatory.
Talk to the Observatory professor on the floor 2. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Stellar Born'.]
After the cutscene, return to Zolarea via the portal at the crash site west of Piscatoris.
Talk to Wizard Rosalina in the centre of the island.
Enter the cave entrance to the west.
Talk to Wizard Rosalina.
Exit the cave.
Gather the dark star wisps that have appeared. Wisps are visible on the minimap as a yellow dot:

sub.t: A bit north of the cave, west of the mysterious decay. (1/5)
Jump the rocky edge to the north and gather the wisp on the small, north-north-western island. (2/5)
Return to the east side of the main island and gather the wisp near the meteorites. (The mining symbol on your minimap) (3/5)
Go to the south side of the island and gather the wisp near the rocky edge. (4/5)
Jump the rocky edge to the south and gather the wisp on the south-easternmost island. (5/5)

p: Performing the dark star rite with the star sprites.

steps.t: Return to the cave and talk to Wizard Rosalina. [Chat: 1 Could we sacrifice a star sprite? › 2 Could we sacrifice Blip? › 3 Could I sacrifice myself? › 4 Could we sacrifice you?]
Select the star sprites in the following order:

sub.t: Wave 3: Zig, Eetee, Bop, Eetee, Glorp

steps.t: Exit the cave and talk to Wizard Rosalina in the centre. [Chat: 1 Yes please!]
Talk to Wizard Rosalina back at the crash site.
Quest complete!
